name: Dev Tools
description: Sandboxed, fully offline, one minimal permission (local UI storage only). 42 tools in ~150KB: password/QR/barcode/ID generators, hash & HMAC, AES encryption, JWT, TOTP, RSA keys, certificate decoder, Base64/32/58, timestamp/duration/timezone/cron, HTTP headers, CSS gradient & shadow, CIDR subnetting, text diff, color & contrast, regex tester, mojibake fixer and more.
releaseNotes: Two new tools (42 total, ~150KB): HTTP helper (raw headers ⇄ JSON + status code/header reference) and a CSS generator (gradients, box-shadow, live preview). Time tool gains timezone conversion with bare-offset input (+8, UTC+8) and a local-zone shortcut; color gains harmony palettes; case converter gains URL slugs; ID generator gains deterministic UUID v5/v3. UI: 23 consolidated category chips capped at two rows, collapsible all-tools grids, privacy switch for recents, favorites empty-state card, persisted typewriter toggle, ⌘K/Ctrl+K search focus.

zh-CN.name: Dev 工具集
zh-CN.description: 沙箱离线运行，零联网、仅1项本地权限。42 款开发工具仅 ~150KB：密码生成、哈希/HMAC、AES、JWT/TOTP、RSA/证书、多进制编解码、时间戳/时区与 Cron、HTTP 工具、CSS 生成器、IP 子网、文本 Diff、颜色与配色、Unicode 检查、乱码修复、正则测试等一应俱全。
